_comment: The starred default values a K2's PROMOTION_TERMS_V1 may take, copied verbatim from the frozen plan texts, one source reference each (document, section, quoted words, the number as written, its unit). Nothing here is invented: a value with no source in those texts is absent (see not_set), and a layer whose metric is not yet defined is not usable. Supplied to the K2 freeze program as ctx.promotionTermsStar; an AI-authored draft must equal it, a human-authored one states its own values. To be frozen by plan-coord from the PR that adds it.
